recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit as-is. No follow-up is needed for FHIR-6176 unless a future documents-page rewrite removes the Composition.subject link or explanation.
issue_request: FHIR-6176 was Published/Persuasive for FHIR-core-documents and asked to replace the confusing phrase "The Subject resource" with wording that identifies the subject as Composition.subject, because there is no standalone Subject Resource.
initial_application: The Jira comment records svn revision 6187. Git commit 95b22dc12b446a3d6f8de205c403050e1465e53d maps to that revision and changed source/documents.html from "The Subject resource" to a lower-case linked "subject resource" pointing to composition-definitions.html#Composition.subject.
additional_context: source/documents.html is in current build scope through publish.ini. Later FHIR-39121 editorial work retained the linked list item and added prose saying that the subject resource is typically a Patient and is referenced in Composition.subject. The Composition.subject definition itself says who or what the composition is about. Zulip/Confluence checks found no conflicting community or WG record; the relevant Zulip thread confirmed that the document subject means Composition.subject.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current built source already implements the requested clarification and later edits reinforce rather than contradict it.
